title: Two weeks in Japan
scene: Max visits a friend in Tokyo. He eats sushi and ramen, buys manga, sees a woman in a kimono and a geisha under the sakura trees, learns table etiquette from his senpai, and stays inside during a typhoon.

words.ex: We had sushi for dinner last night.
We ate hot ramen on a cold night.
My son reads manga every night before bed.
She wore a beautiful kimono at the festival.
We saw a geisha walking in the old part of town.
The sakura bloom in early spring.
Good table etiquette is important at dinners.
She asked her senpai for advice.
A typhoon hit the coast last night.

title: Backpacking in Asia
scene: Anna's friend Lisa goes backpacking in Asia and sleeps in cheap hostels. In Seoul she eats kimchi with fans of a K-pop oppa, in China she eats bao and a mandarin and pays in yuan, in Vietnam she rides a moped and pays in dong, and in Thailand she pays in baht and tries durian and papaya; a doctor talks about malaria, cholera and quarantine.

words.ex: We stayed in a cheap hostel in Rome.
I like to eat kimchi with rice and eggs.
Fans screamed oppa when the singer appeared.
We ordered pork bao for lunch.
She peeled a mandarin for her son.
The bag cost fifty yuan in Beijing.
He rides a moped to work every day.
The dong is the currency of Vietnam.
This shirt costs two hundred baht.
Durian smells strong but tastes sweet.
I eat papaya with lime for breakfast.
Mosquitoes spread malaria in many hot countries.

title: A wedding in India
scene: Anna's friend from college invites her to a wedding in India. The women wear saris, the men wear dhotis and turbans, a Sikh uncle tells stories about an old raja and a British sahib, a snake charmer shows a cobra, and at a temple puja a mystic reads Sanskrit and gives everyone prasad.

words.ex: She wore a beautiful red sari to the wedding.
He wore a white dhoti for the festival.
He wears a turban to work every day.
Many Sikhs wear a turban as part of their faith.
The raja lived in a huge palace.
In the old story, the servant called him sahib.
The cobra raised its head and hissed.
The family does a puja every morning.
The old mystic spent years in prayer.
Sanskrit is an ancient language of India.
After the prayer, we received prasad.

title: Istanbul, Dubai and Cairo
scene: Max's parents travel around the Middle East. In Istanbul they shop in a bazaar, pay in lira and hear about a pasha who ruled the city; in Dubai they meet a sheikh in his emirate and pay in dinars on the way; they ride to an oasis, see a mirage and a scorpion, and in Egypt they hear a mullah, see the Sphinx and the Nile delta.

words.ex: We bought spices and carpets at the bazaar.
This coffee costs fifty lira in Istanbul.
The pasha ruled the city for many years.
The sheikh welcomed the guests to his palace.
Dubai is one of the seven emirates.
The taxi to the hotel cost five dinars.
The travelers stopped at an oasis in the desert.
The lake in the desert was just a mirage.
A scorpion was hiding in my shoe this morning.
The mullah led the prayers at the mosque.
We saw the Great Sphinx in Egypt.
The river forms a delta near the sea.
She wore an amulet to protect her.

title: A safari in Kenya
scene: Anna's aunt books a safari in Kenya through her travel agent. Near the equator, in the tropics of another continent, she sees hyenas and gazelles on the savanna, pays in shillings and buys shea butter; then she flies to South Africa and pays in rand.

words.ex: We went on a safari in Kenya.
My travel agent books our hotels.
Ecuador is a country right on the equator.
We spent our vacation in the tropics.
How many continents have you been to?
A hyena laughed in the dark.
A gazelle can run very fast to escape lions.
Lions hunt on the African savanna.
The bus ride costs fifty shillings.
This lotion is made with shea butter.
The rand is the currency of South Africa.

title: Max in Latin America
scene: Max travels in Mexico and Peru. His new amigo pays in pesos, they drink tequila and margaritas among the cacti and dance the mambo to bongos, see a llama, a puma and a condor in the mountains and coca fields, and cut through the Amazon jungle with a machete, where caimans and piranhas live.

words.ex: Hey amigo, how are you doing?
The taxi ride cost two hundred pesos.
We ordered two shots of tequila with lime.
She ordered a margarita with salt on the rim.
A cactus needs very little water to grow.
The llama carried our bags up the mountain.
A puma was seen near the hiking trail.
We saw a condor flying over the mountains.
Coca grows in the mountains of South America.
He used a machete to cut through the thick jungle.
A caiman rested on the river bank.
Piranhas have very sharp teeth and strong jaws.

title: Australia and the islands
scene: Anna's cousin works at a beach resort in Australia. He sees kangaroos, koalas and a wild dingo, throws a boomerang, eats crab, sleeps in a bungalow during a cyclone, and on an island he plays the ukulele in a deluxe room, sees tourists in bikinis on a topless beach, a wooden tiki and a volcano with hot lava in its crater.

words.ex: We stayed at a beach resort last summer.
A kangaroo can jump very far.
A koala can sleep up to twenty hours a day.
The dingo is a wild dog that lives in Australia.
He threw the boomerang and it came back.
We ate fresh crab at the beach.
They live in a small bungalow by the sea.
A strong cyclone hit the island last night.
She wore a red bikini to the beach.
Topless sunbathing is not allowed on this beach.
A wooden tiki stood at the entrance of the bar.
Hot lava flowed down the mountain.
I'm learning to play the ukulele.

title: A week in New York
scene: Anna and Max spend a week in New York. They walk downtown on a wide boulevard, see Chinatown and the huge billboards, eat bagels with cream cheese and French toast at brunch, steak and lobster for dinner and pecan pie, find a dime on the street and visit a friend's penthouse.

words.ex: We live about ten minutes from downtown.
We walked down the wide boulevard after dinner.
We had dumplings in Chinatown last night.
There is a big billboard on the highway.
I eat a bagel with cream cheese for breakfast.
Can I have a bagel with cream cheese, please?
I make French toast with eggs, milk, and bread.
Let's meet for brunch on Sunday.
I'd like my steak medium rare, please.
We ate fresh lobster at a seaside restaurant.
I found a dime under the couch cushion.
They live in a penthouse with a city view.

title: Dad's small bakery
scene: Anna's dad becomes a businessman: he opens a small bakery with a business partner. They write a business plan, check the cash flow and the profit, decide on their pricing, choose a vendor for flour, talk to a retailer about retail, hire a sales manager, join a farmers' cooperative and sometimes use barter.

words.ex: My uncle is a successful businessman in Kyiv.
My business partner and I opened a cafe together.
She wrote a business plan for her new bakery.
The company has a cash flow problem.
The shop made a small profit this year.
Our pricing is simple and clear.
We chose a new software vendor this year.
This retailer sells clothes online and in stores.
My sister has worked in retail for five years.
The sales manager wants better numbers this month.
The farmers in our village formed a cooperative.
They used barter instead of money.
The company is the main distributor in the region.

title: Max's startup
scene: Max and two friends start their own startup. The founder explains the concept, the business model and a use case to an investor, who sees a game changer and a win-win deal; he offers venture capital for their know-how, they get a patent, and later they plan a joint venture and a spin-off.

words.ex: She works at a tech startup.
I met the founder of the company at a conference.
I really like the concept of this new cafe.
Their business model is based on monthly subscriptions.
Can you give me a simple use case for this app?
We need an investor for our small business.
This new phone app is a real game changer for small shops.
This deal is a win-win situation for both companies.
Their new business venture is doing very well.
They need more capital to start the business.
She has the know-how to fix old cars.
She got a patent for her invention.
He was a great innovator in medicine.

title: Anna's marketing seminar
scene: At a marketing seminar Anna studies a case study about branding. She creates a logo and a slogan with an art director, plans targeting for the mass market, reads what the respondents said, compares the results with a benchmark, and learns about merchandising, promotion and gift vouchers.

words.ex: My sister works in marketing at a big company.
I have a seminar on marketing tomorrow.
We discussed a case study in today's marketing class.
Good branding helps a company stand out.
The company changed its logo last year.
The company needs a catchy new slogan.
The art director chose the colors for the ad.
Better targeting helps ads reach the right people.
The product is made for the mass market.
Most respondents said they liked the new design.
The new phone scored high on the benchmark.
She works in merchandising for a big clothing store.
The store has a special promotion this week.
Our landing page shows the price and a sign-up button.

title: A tech expo
scene: Anna helps at a tech expo. The keynote speaker is a famous businesswoman and a product manager; sponsors hang banners, a promoter hands out flyers about a bestseller, the PR team sends a press release, and a speaker explains email marketing and a good landing page.

words.ex: We visited a tech expo in Las Vegas.
The CEO gave the keynote at the conference.
My aunt is a successful businesswoman.
The product manager decides which features to build.
The bank is the main sponsor of the race.

They handed out flyers on the street.
